topLine: OpenAI's internal Astra model claims ten results, including the first explicit non-sofic group.

items.headline: OpenAI's internal Astra model claims ten results, including the first explicit non-sofic group
items.summary: OpenAI said an internal version of its next model (later released as GPT-6 Astra) produced ten results. They include an explicit non-sofic group, a counterexample to Connes's rigidity conjecture, Ehrhart's volume conjecture, polynomial-factor hardness for the closest vector problem, and resolutions of Erdős problems 146, 180 and 183. OpenAI published a 249-page manuscript and Lean 4 files for every result. Coverage at launch reported no independent expert verification. Thomas Bloom called the results "big news".
